display_long_description:
Disney+ is the streaming home of your favorite stories. With beloved movies and series from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, and more. Stream the latest movie releases, exclusive Original series, and highly anticipated sports matchups all in Disney+. Soon, you will be able to experience select favorite stories in 3D* with one of our exclusive Disney+ environments.


*The 3D content and video quality available on Disney+ may vary by region, plan and device. Some titles shown above may not be available in your country. 


For help with Disney+: http://help.disneyplus.com


For our Subscriber Agreement and other policies: https://disneyplus.com/legal/subscriber-agreement


Your US State Privacy Rights:  privacy.twdc.com/state


Do Not Sell or Share My Information: https://privacy.thewaltdisneycompany.com/en/dnssmpi/


Disney+ Subscription required. Must be 18+ to subscribe. You must have the latest version of Horizon OS installed.
